comments.content: The logging middleware is now registered after CORS and Metrics, whereas previously it was registered before them. This changes the middleware execution order: previously Logging wrapped CORS and Metrics, so it would log requests even if CORS or Metrics short-circuited. Now CORS and Metrics run first, and if either does not call the next handler, the request will not be logged. This is a behavioral change that may be unintended. Consider preserving the original order by conditionally selecting the logging middleware before the other middlewares, e.g., build the middleware list dynamically.
